editorial: Costa Rica has tropical temperatures throughout the year, but condensation levels vary.
If Monteverde is your main port of call, as it was for us, plan a trip between May and November.
If you prefer drier weather (and plan to hit the beaches), visit during December to April.

seasons.title: MAY TO NOVEMBER
editorial: We visited in October, which is the peak of the wet season. While there were afternoon showers during our stay in Monteverde, but more importantly, the clouds part of the cloud forest did not disappoint.

seasons.title: DECEMBER TO APRIL
editorial: Afternoon showers could ruin a beach vacation however, and if Playa Manuel Antonio is on your itinerary, then you’re better off visiting during the dry season.
There’s definitely a trade-off here as Monteverde may not be as ethereal as when the clouds converge upon it.
